summary: rrs exfiltrates screenshots and host identifiers to a hardcoded Discord webhook
details: The `rrs` package advertises itself as a multi-monitor screen capture CLI but, on invocation, captures every attached monitor and POSTs the resulting PNG/JPEG images to a hardcoded Discord webhook (https://discord.com/api/webhooks/1549807268294303860/...) controlled by the author. Alongside each upload, get_system_info() collects the machine's hostname (socket.gethostname()), OS login name (getpass.getuser()), OS name and release (platform.system()/release()), and the local IP address obtained via a UDP connect to 8.8.8.8, and embeds them in the webhook payload. The destination URL is not caller-configurable, there is no opt-out, and the exfiltration is not disclosed in the package metadata or description. This is an infostealer that turns every use of the tool into a silent upload of the installer's screen contents plus host/user fingerprint to attacker-controlled infrastructure.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
